items.stem: What do we learn about Sherry Christian?

choices.text: She is making a special effort to be recognized.
choices.zh: 她正在特别努力以获得认可。

choices.text: She has been living in Fayetteville for 25 years.
choices.zh: 她已在Fayetteville生活了25年。

choices.text: She has been driving a school bus ever since 2009.
choices.zh: 她自2009年以来一直驾驶校车。

choices.text: She is the longest-serving bus driver in Fayetteville.
choices.zh: 她是Fayetteville服务时间最长的公交车司机。

items.stem: What did city officials of Fayetteville want bus drivers to be aware of?

choices.text: The importance of their service to the city.
choices.zh: 他们为这座城市提供的服务的重要性。

choices.text: The number of riders they serve in the city.
choices.zh: 他们在这座城市服务的乘客数量。

choices.text: The new proclamation issued early this week.
choices.zh: 本周早些时候发布的新公告。

choices.text: The significance of the event to take place March 18.
choices.zh: 将于3月18日举行的活动的重要意义。

items.stem: What does the news report say the Wilton School Board has done?

choices.text: Budgeted $56.7 million for the coming school year.
choices.zh: 为即将到来的学年预算了 5670 万美元。

choices.text: Requested to raise teachers' salaries by 3 percent.
choices.zh: 要求将教师工资提高 3%。

choices.text: Proposed a spending increase by 5.99 percent.
choices.zh: 提议将开支增加 5.99%。

choices.text: Kept raising funds for at least 8 budget cycles.
choices.zh: 在至少 8 个预算周期内持续筹集资金。

items.stem: What will a decline in the total enrollment lead to?

choices.text: Decrease in salaries for school administrators.
choices.zh: 学校管理人员工资减少。

choices.text: Reduction in federal and state funding.
choices.zh: 联邦和州资助减少。

choices.text: Firing of less qualified faculty members.
choices.zh: 解雇资质较低的教职员工。

choices.text: Closing down of some less competitive schools.
choices.zh: 关闭一些竞争力较弱的学校。

items.stem: What do we learn about thundersnows from the report?

choices.text: They often take place in the Scottish highlands.
choices.zh: 它们经常发生在苏格兰高地。

choices.text: They usually happen in the middle of the night.
choices.zh: 它们通常发生在午夜时分。

choices.text: Their damage can be as serious as that of bombs.
choices.zh: 它们造成的破坏可能与炸弹一样严重。

choices.text: Their loud claps can be confused with explosions.
choices.zh: 它们的巨大响声可能会与爆炸声混淆。

items.stem: What did the police do when they received the local residents' phone calls?

choices.text: They sent out a message to calm them down.
choices.zh: 他们发出了一条消息让居民冷静下来。

choices.text: They promised to stop the construction work.
choices.zh: 他们承诺停止施工作业。

choices.text: They told them the military exercise was over.
choices.zh: 他们告诉居民军事演习已经结束。

choices.text: They set off to inspect the site of the plane crash.
choices.zh: 他们出发前往检查飞机坠毁现场。

items.stem: What were people advised to do when traveling outside?

choices.text: Keep warm.
choices.zh: 保持温暖。

choices.text: Take caution.
choices.zh: 小心谨慎。

choices.text: Avoid driving.
choices.zh: 避免驾车。

choices.text: Use rail service.
choices.zh: 使用铁路服务。

items.stem: What does the woman say she was actually wondering about?

choices.text: Why the man is so anxious to buy a new phone.
choices.zh: 为什么男士如此急于购买新手机。

choices.text: How the man could possibly afford a new phone.
choices.zh: 男士怎么可能负担得起新手机。

choices.text: How the man got into the habit of being wasteful.
choices.zh: 男士是如何养成浪费习惯的。

choices.text: Why the man is so fond of using his credit card.
choices.zh: 为什么男士如此喜欢使用信用卡。

items.stem: Why is the man a little embarrassed by the phone he's using now?

choices.text: It is not in fashion any more.
choices.zh: 它已经不再流行了。

choices.text: It goes out of order frequently.
choices.zh: 它经常出现故障。

choices.text: It is not as fancy as his colleagues'.
choices.zh: 它不如他同事的手机高级。

choices.text: It lacks functions office work requires.
choices.zh: 它缺少办公工作所需的功能。

items.stem: What does the man say about the credit card he just got?

choices.text: It enables him to buy a new phone at a more favorable price.
choices.zh: 它使他能够以更优惠的价格购买新手机。

choices.text: It is a special offer to recent college graduates working in offices.
choices.zh: 这是为刚毕业在办公室工作的大学生提供的特别优惠。

choices.text: It is available to office workers who have a good enough credit score.
choices.zh: 信用评分足够好的办公室职员可以办理。

choices.text: It allows him to borrow money without paying interest for six months.
choices.zh: 它允许他借款六个月不用支付利息。

items.stem: What do we learn about one of the woman's colleagues?

choices.text: She borrowed money to pay her debt.
choices.zh: 她借钱来偿还债务。

choices.text: She developed a habit of overspending.
choices.zh: 她养成了过度消费的习惯。

choices.text: She enjoys buying a lot of fancy things.
choices.zh: 她喜欢购买很多高级物品。

choices.text: She regrets ignoring the woman's advice.
choices.zh: 她后悔没有听从女士的建议。

items.stem: What does the tiny home movement mainly advocate?

choices.text: Blog writing and natural resources saving.
choices.zh: 博客写作和节约自然资源。

choices.text: Joint efforts to improve the local community.
choices.zh: 共同努力改善当地社区。

choices.text: Audience participation in The Morning Show.
choices.zh: 观众参与《早间节目》。

choices.text: Home ownership and environmental protection.
choices.zh: 拥有住房和环境保护。

items.stem: What does the woman say about houses as small as 20 square meters?

choices.text: Not a realistic size for families.
choices.zh: 对家庭来说不是现实的面积。

choices.text: Not welcomed by most Americans.
choices.zh: 不受大多数美国人欢迎。

choices.text: Only fit for families of four or less.
choices.zh: 只适合四口或四口以下的家庭。

choices.text: Only suitable for renting to the poor.
choices.zh: 只适合出租给穷人。

items.stem: What does the man think about the dream of owning a 150-square-meter house?

choices.text: It should be changed.
choices.zh: 应该改变。

choices.text: It isn't easy to realize.
choices.zh: 不容易实现。

choices.text: It will come true sooner or later.
choices.zh: 迟早会实现。

choices.text: It doesn't appeal to average families.
choices.zh: 不吸引普通家庭。

items.stem: What does the man say about tiny homes?

choices.text: They help to lower housing prices.
choices.zh: 它们有助于降低住房价格。

choices.text: They help to save up for larger houses.
choices.zh: 它们有助于为更大的住宅攒钱。

choices.text: They are a good choice for many people.
choices.zh: 它们对许多人来说是一个好选择。

choices.text: They are vital to reducing waste worldwide.
choices.zh: 它们对于减少全球浪费至关重要。

items.stem: What do children seem to have a natural desire to do?

choices.text: Play outdoors and enjoy themselves.
choices.zh: 在户外玩耍并享受乐趣。

choices.text: Beat challenges and take risks.
choices.zh: 战胜挑战并承担风险。

choices.text: Take care of their well-being.
choices.zh: 照顾自己的健康。

choices.text: Grow up strong and healthy.
choices.zh: 健康强壮地成长。

items.stem: According to the American Psychological Association, what does regular physical activity do to children?

choices.text: Enable them to develop their motor skills.
choices.zh: 使他们能够发展运动技能。

choices.text: Help them to conceal their frustration.
choices.zh: 帮助他们掩饰挫败感。

choices.text: Reduce their stress and depression.
choices.zh: 减轻他们的压力和抑郁。

choices.text: Prevent them from feeling lonely.
choices.zh: 防止他们感到孤独。

items.stem: What does the passage say about cultivating the habit of physical activity?

choices.text: It begins early.
choices.zh: 它从早期开始。

choices.text: It proves demanding.
choices.zh: 它证明很费力。

choices.text: It calls for lifelong efforts.
choices.zh: 它需要终身努力。

choices.text: It lies in nature experiences.
choices.zh: 它在于自然体验。

items.stem: When are job seekers willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, according to a new study?

choices.text: When companies share their information online.
choices.zh: 当公司在网上分享其信息时。

choices.text: When their job search criteria are met fully.
choices.zh: 当他们的求职标准得到充分满足时。

choices.text: When companies embrace greater diversity
choices.zh: 当公司拥抱更大的多样性时。

choices.text: When they find job postings visually attractive.
choices.zh: 当他们发现招聘信息在视觉上有吸引力时。

items.stem: What did participants see in the baseline condition of the study?

choices.text: Emails in the normal format.
choices.zh: 正常格式的电子邮件。

choices.text: Major companies in one location.
choices.zh: 一个地点的主要公司。

choices.text: All companies in the same sector.
choices.zh: 同一行业的所有公司。

choices.text: Various aspects of a company's workforce.
choices.zh: 公司员工队伍的各个方面。

items.stem: What does the passage say participants seem to be paying attention to?

choices.text: Job security.
choices.zh: 工作保障。

choices.text: Potential pay raises.
choices.zh: 潜在的加薪。

choices.text: Minimum base salary.
choices.zh: 最低基本工资。

choices.text: Information about diversity.
choices.zh: 关于多样性的信息。

items.stem: What does the passage say about the findings of a new study from Oregon State University?

choices.text: Positive.
choices.zh: 积极的

choices.text: Original.
choices.zh: 原创的

choices.text: Important.
choices.zh: 重要的

choices.text: Surprising.
choices.zh: 令人惊讶的

items.stem: What does a growing body of evidence show according to the passage?

choices.text: Dogs match their behavior with kids as much as with adults.
choices.zh: 狗对儿童的行为表现与对成年人的一样多

choices.text: Kids and adults alike find in dogs a source of attachment.
choices.zh: 儿童和成年人都在狗身上找到了依恋的来源

choices.text: Kids' attitude to dogs is influenced by adults.
choices.zh: 儿童对狗的态度受到成年人的影响

choices.text: Dogs can help kids in many ways.
choices.zh: 狗可以在许多方面帮助儿童

items.stem: What did Monique Udell say their study suggests?

choices.text: Dogs pay much attention to the kids they live with.
choices.zh: 狗对与它们一起生活的儿童十分关注

choices.text: Dogs view both adults and kids as social companions.
choices.zh: 狗将成年人和儿童都视为社交伙伴

choices.text: Kids differ from adults in their behavior towards dogs.
choices.zh: 儿童对狗的行为不同于成年人

choices.text: Kids need to be aware of the risks in playing with dogs.
choices.zh: 儿童需要意识到与狗玩耍的风险

items.stem: What does research show kids are very capable of doing?

choices.text: Understanding dogs.
choices.zh: 理解狗

choices.text: Training dogs.
choices.zh: 训练狗

choices.text: Taking care of dogs.
choices.zh: 照顾狗

choices.text: Associating with dogs.
choices.zh: 与狗交往
